title: Time Nap
description: A mod that allows you to sleep and wake up at any time of the day.
body:
Soo this mod basically adds a feature for the beds where you can take a nap at any moment and choose what time you want to wake up.
Pretty simple to use just right click a bed at any time of the day, choose a time you want to wake up to and **BOOM** you did it
